findings.detail: Reverse connections were retired in v0.9.0 (ADR-0068), but this machine still has settings or a service unit for them. They have no effect, and qsh serve refuses to start while [serve].to or [reverse].controller is set. (left over: [listen], [serve].to, listen service unit)
findings.remedy: Remove each key with `qsh config unset <section>.<key>` and the unit with `qsh service uninstall`. To be reachable, run `qsh serve` and pin this machine's key on the other side (`qsh trust add <name> --key ...`).
